text_block_list.text:
I rush Кинг Хало to the infirmary after
she gets
injured.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even monkeys fall from trees, and even
Homer
sometimes nods. Which means
that my mistakes...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Are just stepping stones to success! Let
me try
again, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
You worry too much. An injury like this
will heal in
no time.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Just you watch how fast I heal up...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Really?! Fantastic! Then, without further
ado...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
...I would like to amend my earlier
statement at
this time.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Instead of "my mistakes are stepping
stones to
success,'' what I should have
said is "my mistakes
are not mistakes at
all.''
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
If you don't acknowledge a mistake, it
doesn't
exist... Understood?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Okay, let's take some deep breaths. Inhale... exhale...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
We just need to relax. Being too
conscious of
previous mistakes only
leads to more.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I won't make the same mistake
again. Like I
said, my mistakes are
stepping stones to success!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало lets out another frustrated
sigh.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало's resolve to always move
forward no
matter her mistakes has never
been more
apparent.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало's expression remains
unpleasant for
some time after that.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
